zh.summary: 理解 AI 每次實際取得的資訊、上下文容量與有效使用的差別，透過預算互動與可交接的工作資料，保留正確規格和驗證證據。
objectives: 區分聊天介面保存的歷史與某次模型呼叫實際取得的上下文。
用明示假設的 token 預算，辨識超出容量及無關資訊擁擠的問題。
為長任務保留可重新讀取的規格、狀態與來源，避免只靠對話記憶。

readingGuide.goal: 為一次模型呼叫安排有限、相關且可回查的上下文。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先把聊天歷史與目前真正需要的規格、程式和測試結果分開。
readingGuide.route: 讀工作桌類比，計算合成預算，再替一次修正任務設計工作包。
readingGuide.output: 一份註明假設的預算與含來源、版本、未決問題的任務摘要。

sections.heading: 一、把 Context Window 想成工程師的工作桌
paragraphs: 大型語言模型（LLM）每一次回答，主要依靠當次實際取得的資訊。它無法保證隨時翻閱所有過去紀錄。先記住三句話：資料有保存，不代表 AI 這一次看得到；AI 看得到，不代表它一定會正確理解與使用；可靠的 AI 工作流程，要確保它每次取得正確資料，並驗證結果。
想像你聘請了一位非常聰明的工程師，他會寫程式、處理資料、設計網站。公司有一間很大的資料室，存放數千份文件；但工程師工作的時候，只能看見當下擺在桌上的資料。Context Window（上下文視窗）就是這一次能使用的工作桌空間。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜公司資料室與工程師的工作桌
blocks.description: 必須選取資料，不能假設全部都已讀取。虛線箭頭表示資料選取；Context Window 是工程師這一次能使用的工作桌空間。

items.title: 公司資料室
items.body: 保存的聊天紀錄、文件、程式碼、資料庫

items.title: 工程師的工作桌
items.body:
本次真正取得的規則
本次需求
相關資料

blocks.heading: 1,000 份文件，這次只拿到 10 份
paragraphs: 假設公司保存了 1,000 份文件，工程師這一次只拿到 10 份。第 237 份文件記載重要的安全規則，但沒有人把它拿到桌上；即使工程師能力再強，也不能保證他知道那份文件的內容。AI 也是如此。
當 ChatGPT 或 Coding Agent 沒有遵守之前訂下的規則，先確認：這一次模型實際收到的資料，到底有沒有包含那項規則？這是判斷上下文問題的第一步。

sections.heading: 二、AI 的工作桌上，到底放了什麼？
paragraphs: 一次模型呼叫（Model Invocation），通常不只有你剛剛輸入的問題。下圖列出一次 AI 工作可能需要的資料與預留空間；實際封裝與容量規則依模型及服務而異。
Token 是模型處理資訊的基本單位，不保證等於一個中文字或英文單字。Context Window 的容量通常用 Token 數量表示；很長的程式碼、十份文件與大量測試日誌，都可能占用這次工作的上下文容量。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜一次 AI 工作可能包含的資料
blocks.description: 模型根據當次取得的資訊產生回答。五列是組成示意，並非五個先後步驟；預留回答表示容量規劃，實際封裝與容量規則依服務而異。

items.title: 系統規則
items.body: AI 必須遵守的工作要求

items.title: 你現在的問題
items.body: 例如：修改網站的按鈕顏色

items.title: 歷史對話或摘要
items.body: 之前討論過的設計與決策

items.title: 外部資料及工具回傳
items.body: 程式碼、文件、Git 內容、測試輸出

items.title: 預留回答空間
items.body: 留給模型接下來產生的內容

blocks.heading: 訓練知識、聊天歷史、Memory 與目前 Context
paragraphs: 模型在訓練中學到的知識、聊天歷史、外部 Memory（記憶）與目前 Context（上下文）是不同的東西。訓練知識反映在模型參數中；歷史、Memory 或外部文件則需要經過相應的選取與提供機制，才會成為這次可用的上下文。
例如 Git 裡已經有 requirements.md，不代表 AI 這一次真的讀取了這個檔案。要確認是否取得有效規則，需要檢查讀取的路徑、版本及工具回傳內容。

sections.heading: 三、實際操作：為什麼 Context Window 會不夠用？
paragraphs: 這裡使用一個 10,000 Token 的假想模型，總上限包含預留回答。這是可以操作的教學模擬，數字是教學指定值，並非任何真實模型或 Tokenizer 的量測。
固定內容包括系統規則 1,000、需求與程式 2,000、測試紀錄 4,500，以及預留回答 1,500，合計 9,000 Token。額外日誌預設 500，因此目前需求總量是 9,500，剩餘容量是 500 Token。

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜上下文預算互動
blocks.description: 假設上限 10,000 Token，輸入與預留回答共用預算。以下數值是日誌 500 的靜態預設；容量足夠不保證資訊被正確使用。這不是任何特定模型的實際限制。

blocks.heading: 日誌變多，是否真的增加有用資訊？
paragraphs: 把額外日誌調到 1,800 Token，總需求就成為 10,800，超過容量 800。相較預設值，多出來的 1,300 Token 日誌，不代表 AI 更了解你的需求。若它們只重複列印「服務啟動成功」，就占用了空間，卻可能沒有帶來有用資訊。
AI 工程也需要 Context Management（上下文管理）：選取、摘要與分段，讓有限容量留給本次需要的規格和證據。容量裝得下，不代表 AI 一定會正確使用每項資訊。日誌 1,000 時恰好滿額，3,000 時超出 2,000；下方程式可離線核對這些算術。

blocks.heading: 用 Python 離線核對
paragraphs: 使用 Python 3 標準函式庫，把程式存為 context_budget.py，執行 python3 context_budget.py。預期 reserved = 9500、remaining = 500、fits = True。把 extra_logs 改為 1800 後，預期 10800、-800、False。
blocks.code:
window = 10000
input_parts = {"rules": 1000, "requirements_and_code": 2000, "test_records": 4500}
output_reserve = 1500
extra_logs = 500
reserved = sum(input_parts.values()) + output_reserve + extra_logs
remaining = window - reserved
print("reserved =", reserved)
print("remaining =", remaining)
print("fits =", remaining >= 0)

sections.heading: 四、Context Window 很大，為什麼 AI 還是可能做錯？
paragraphs: 想像你在設計一個網站，第一天已規定採用暖象牙白與陶土紅，四天之後 AI 卻將網站改成紫色。僅憑這個結果，還不能直接判定「AI 忘記了」。
至少有四種不同原因：容量不足、資料選錯、資料衝突、使用失誤。它們需要不同的檢查與處理方式，不能只靠增加 Context Window 一次解決。

blocks.caption: 四種問題與改善方向
rows: 桌上根本沒有正確規格
新舊配色規則混在一起
規則就在眼前，但 AI 仍然做錯

blocks.heading: Lost in the Middle：資訊位置也可能影響使用
paragraphs: Lost in the Middle 研究在特定多文件問答與鍵值檢索任務中，觀察到資訊的位置可能影響模型使用該資訊的表現；位於長上下文中間的資訊，有時較難被有效使用。這不是所有模型與任務都必然遵循的定律。
因此，容量大小和有效理解能力是兩個不同維度。一次能放多少、這次取得什麼、哪份規則有效，以及執行是否正確，仍需分別檢查。

sections.heading: 五、工程實務：建立真正的工作交接
paragraphs: 假設你和 Coding Agent 花了三天開發一個醫院收件系統，現在發現：「使用者缺少必填文件，系統竟然仍顯示收件完成。」
如果只說「幫我繼續修正，按照之前的規定處理」，Agent 可能不知道「之前規定」是哪個版本。把有效規格、錯誤證據及工作邊界寫成任務工作包（Task Package），交接時就能重新取得。

blocks.caption: 任務工作包｜可交接的 AI 任務
blocks.description: 以上檔名、需求及測試都是教材的虛構案例。七欄平行描述同一任務，並非七個執行步驟。

items.title: 工作目標
items.body: 修正收件完成狀態的判斷錯誤

items.title: 有效規格
items.body: docs/requirements-v3.md

items.title: 錯誤證據
items.body: 測試 T-04：缺少必填附件仍顯示完成

items.title: 未決問題
items.body: 選填文件是否影響完成狀態

items.title: 修改範圍
items.body: 僅修改狀態判斷與相關測試

items.title: 停止條件
items.body: 遇到需求衝突先回報

items.title: 完成標準
items.body: T-04 測試通過，並提供實際結果

blocks.heading: Source of Truth：可信的規格正本
paragraphs: 即使換一個新的 AI Agent，它也能按照明確的任務資料繼續工作，不必依賴三天前的對話紀錄。軟體專案可將規格、測試與版本紀錄保存在 Git，交接時再明確讀取。
Source of Truth（可信的規格正本）表示：多份文件或對話說法不一致時，要明確知道哪份有效規格具有權威性，讓 Agent 有依據可查。

blocks.caption: 圖 4｜可靠的 Agent 工作循環
blocks.description: 向下箭頭表示工作順序。確認新決策後，更新規格正本供下次使用；這個回饋關係以文字明示，並非執行後自動完成。

items.title: 規格正本與版本紀錄
items.body: 確認現在有效的規則

items.title: 選取本次需要的 Context
items.body: 包含正確文件、程式與必要證據

items.title: AI Agent 執行工作
items.body: 讀取、分析、修改、執行工具

items.title: 測試與審查結果
items.body: 確認真的符合規格，並回查實際結果

blocks.heading: Context Engineering：讓每次工作取得合適資料
paragraphs: 這套作法屬於 Context Engineering（上下文工程）：設計模型應該取得什麼資訊、什麼時候取得、如何保留有效狀態，以及如何減少無關資料干擾。
測試與審查要回到實際證據，不能僅相信 AI 宣稱完成。確認了新決策，就更新規格正本，讓下次選取資料時取得有效版本。

sections.heading: 六、對話太長，要不要重新開一個？
paragraphs: 當目標一致、需求沒有衝突、相關資料仍然清楚，可以繼續原本的對話。長度本身不足以決定是否重新開始。
當需求已多次變動、累積大量與任務無關的訊息，或 Agent 持續引用過期規格時，適合先建立交接資料，再開啟新的工作階段。
開新對話本身不會修復錯誤規格。如果把錯誤摘要交給新 Agent，它仍然可能繼續犯錯。下一課 M02-03 會說明：Compaction 用來壓縮歷史、RAG 用來檢索資料、Memory 用來保存可供後續使用的資訊；這些方法能協助管理長任務，仍需驗證結果是否正確。

sections.heading: 七、理解檢核：你能診斷 AI 為什麼犯錯嗎？
paragraphs: 假設你讓 Coding Agent 開發醫院內部系統。昨天已明確要求：「只有管理員可以刪除病歷相關紀錄。」今天 Agent 卻把刪除功能開放給所有登入使用者。這是合成教學情境，不包含真實病人資料。
請回答問題 1 與問題 2，再展開參考答案核對。遇到 AI 工作失誤時，先區分「沒有取得資料」、「取得了錯誤版本」和「已取得正確資料但仍執行錯誤」，再選擇對應的修正方式。

exercise.environment: 紙筆或 Python 3；所有 token 數都使用本課題設，不需呼叫真實模型。
steps: 將必要規格、對話歷史與工具結果分成正本、當前必需、可回查三類，說明分類理由。
核對 9,500 的合成預算及剩餘 500；操作滑桿或執行 Python 範例。
把額外日誌設為 1,800 Token，核對超出 800，再決定哪些無關資料先移出工作包。
寫一份供下一次呼叫使用的任務摘要，含規格版本、來源、未決問題及仍需驗證的情境。
exercise.expected: 合成預算的計算與一份可回查來源的工作包；不宣稱這是真實服務的 token 計量。
exercise.check: 能說明「內容能放入」與「任務確實做對」的差別，並指出下一次呼叫需要重新取得哪些資訊。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成筆記；可刪除臨時預算程式，沒有建立外部模型或帳號。

openChecks.prompt: 問題 2：你會怎麼查明真正原因？
answer: 先確認有效規格、版本與管理員限定刪除的原文，再查 Agent 這一次實際讀取的路徑、工具回傳及可取得的上下文。檔案存在或介面可回看歷史，都不足以證明這次取得了規則。
若沒有取得，修正選取或讀取流程；若混入過期規則，明確指定有效版本；若已取得正確規則仍做錯，檢查修改及執行證據。以管理員與一般使用者的授權測試核對實際結果，包含後端拒絕未授權刪除，不能只確認按鈕外觀。容量是否不足則需另查題設以外的實際輸入與服務限制。

en.summary: Distinguish the information available in each AI call, context capacity and effective use. Explore a token budget and prepare handoff records that retain the correct specification and verification evidence.
objectives: Distinguish chat history retained by the interface from context actually supplied to a model call.
Use an explicitly assumed token budget to identify capacity overflow and crowding by irrelevant material.
Retain rereadable specifications, state and sources for long tasks instead of relying only on conversation history.

readingGuide.goal: Prepare finite, relevant and traceable context for one model call.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Separate chat history from the specifications, code and test results currently needed.
readingGuide.route: Use the work-desk analogy, calculate a synthetic budget, then prepare a task packet for one correction.
readingGuide.output: An assumption-labeled budget and a task summary with sources, versions and unresolved questions.

sections.heading: 1. Think of the Context Window as an Engineer’s Desk
paragraphs: A large language model (LLM) mainly relies on information actually available for the current response. It cannot be assumed to consult every past record. Keep three points in mind: stored information may not be available to AI this time; available information may still be misunderstood or misused; a reliable workflow supplies the right information each time and verifies the result.

Imagine hiring a very capable engineer who writes code, processes data and designs websites. The company archive stores thousands of documents, but the engineer can see only what is on the desk during this task. The context window is the working space available this time.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Company Archive and Engineer’s Desk
blocks.description: Information must be selected; do not assume every stored record has been read. The dashed arrow denotes selection. The context window is the engineer’s available working space for this task.

items.title: Company archive
items.body: Stored chats, documents, code and databases

items.title: Engineer’s desk
items.body:
Rules actually available now
Current requirements
Relevant material

blocks.heading: 1,000 Documents Stored, Only 10 Retrieved
paragraphs: Suppose the company stores 1,000 documents and the engineer receives only 10 this time. Document 237 contains an important security rule, but nobody places it on the desk. Even a highly capable engineer cannot be assumed to know its contents. The same distinction applies to AI.

When ChatGPT or a coding agent fails to follow an earlier rule, first ask whether the information actually supplied to this model call included that rule. This is the first step in diagnosing a context problem.

sections.heading: 2. What Is on AI’s Desk?
paragraphs: A model invocation usually involves more than the question you just entered. The figure lists information and reserved space an AI task may need; packaging and capacity rules vary by model and service.

A token is a basic unit of information processed by a model; it is not guaranteed to equal one Chinese character or English word. Context capacity is usually expressed in tokens. Long code, ten documents and extensive test logs can all consume the capacity available for this task.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | What an AI Task May Include
blocks.description: The model generates a response from information actually available in this call. These are five components, not five sequential steps. Output reservation is capacity planning; packaging and limits vary by service.

items.title: System rules
items.body: Requirements AI must follow

items.title: Your current question
items.body: For example: change a website button’s color

items.title: Conversation history or summary
items.body: Previously discussed designs and decisions

items.title: External data and tool results
items.body: Code, documents, Git content and test output

items.title: Reserved response space
items.body: Room for the content the model will generate next

blocks.heading: Training Knowledge, Chat History, Memory and Current Context
paragraphs: Knowledge learned during training, chat history, external memory and current context are distinct. Training knowledge is reflected in model parameters. History, memory or external documents need corresponding selection and delivery mechanisms to become available as context for this call.
For example, requirements.md existing in Git does not establish that AI read it this time. Inspect the path, version and returned tool content to determine whether the valid rule was retrieved.

sections.heading: 3. Try It: Why Does Context Capacity Run Out?
paragraphs: This interactive teaching simulation assumes a model with a 10,000-token limit, including reserved output. The counts are assigned values, not measurements from a real model or tokenizer.

Fixed content consists of 1,000 tokens for system rules, 2,000 for requirements and code, 4,500 for test records and 1,500 reserved for output: 9,000 in total. With the default 500 extra log tokens, demand is 9,500 and remaining capacity is 500.

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | Interactive Context Budget
blocks.description: The assumed limit is 10,000 tokens shared by input and reserved output. These are static defaults with 500 log tokens. Fitting the budget does not guarantee correct use of information, and this is not a real model limit.

blocks.heading: Do More Logs Actually Add Useful Information?
paragraphs: Set extra logs to 1,800 tokens: total demand becomes 10,800, exceeding capacity by 800. The additional 1,300 log tokens relative to the default do not mean AI understands the requirements better. If they merely repeat “service started successfully,” they occupy space while potentially adding no useful information.

AI engineering also needs context management: selection, summarization and splitting work into parts keep limited space available for necessary specifications and evidence. Fitting the content does not guarantee correct use. With 1,000 log tokens the budget is exactly full; with 3,000 it overflows by 2,000. The program below checks this arithmetic offline.

blocks.heading: Check the Budget Offline with Python
paragraphs: Use Python 3 and its standard library. Save this as context_budget.py and run python3 context_budget.py. Expect reserved = 9500, remaining = 500 and fits = True. Set extra_logs to 1800 to obtain 10800, -800 and False.
blocks.code:
window = 10000
input_parts = {"rules": 1000, "requirements_and_code": 2000, "test_records": 4500}
output_reserve = 1500
extra_logs = 500
reserved = sum(input_parts.values()) + output_reserve + extra_logs
remaining = window - reserved
print("reserved =", reserved)
print("remaining =", remaining)
print("fits =", remaining >= 0)

sections.heading: 4. Why Can AI Still Fail with a Large Context Window?
paragraphs: Imagine specifying warm ivory and terracotta red for a website on day one. Four days later, AI changes it to purple. That outcome alone does not establish that AI forgot.

At least four causes are possible: insufficient capacity, incorrect selection, conflicting information and execution error. Each needs different checks and remedies; increasing the context window cannot resolve all four at once.

blocks.caption: Four Problems and Remedies
rows: The desk cannot hold all the material
Read and retrieve the right material
Old and new color rules are mixed
The rule is available, but AI still gets it wrong
Test, review and accept against evidence

blocks.heading: Lost in the Middle: Position Can Affect Information Use
paragraphs: The Lost in the Middle study observed, in specific multi-document question-answering and key-value retrieval tasks, that information position could affect model performance. Information in the middle of a long context was sometimes harder to use effectively. This is not a universal law for every model and task.
Capacity and effective understanding are therefore different dimensions. How much fits, what was retrieved, which rule is valid and whether execution was correct still need separate checks.

sections.heading: 5. Engineering Practice: Build a Real Handoff
paragraphs: Suppose you and a coding agent have spent three days developing a hospital intake system. You discover that it reports intake complete even when the user has not supplied required documents.

If you say only “continue fixing it according to the earlier rules,” the agent may not know which version you mean. A task package makes the governing specification, failure evidence and scope retrievable during handoff.

blocks.caption: Task Package | A Handoff-Ready AI Task
blocks.description: The filenames, requirements and tests are fictional teaching examples. These seven fields describe one task in parallel, rather than seven execution steps.

items.title: Goal
items.body: Fix the logic that determines intake completion

items.title: Valid specification
items.body: docs/requirements-v3.md

items.title: Failure evidence
items.body: Test T-04: missing required attachments still results in complete status

items.title: Open question
items.body: Do optional documents affect completion status?

items.title: Scope
items.body: Change only status logic and related tests

items.title: Stop condition
items.body: Report requirement conflicts before proceeding

items.title: Completion criterion
items.body: T-04 passes and actual results are provided

blocks.heading: Source of Truth: The Authoritative Specification
paragraphs: A new AI agent can continue using explicit task information without relying on a conversation from three days earlier. A software project can retain specifications, tests and version history in Git and read them explicitly at handoff.
A source of truth identifies which valid specification has authority when documents or conversations disagree, giving the agent a record it can consult.

blocks.caption: Figure 4 | A Reliable Agent Work Cycle
blocks.description: Downward arrows indicate work order. After confirming new decisions, update the authoritative specification for the next task. This feedback is stated explicitly; it does not happen automatically after execution.

items.title: Authoritative specification and version history
items.body: Identify the currently valid rules

items.title: Select the context needed now
items.body: Include correct documents, code and necessary evidence

items.title: AI agent performs the task
items.body: Read, analyze, modify and run tools

items.title: Test and review the result
items.body: Confirm specification compliance using actual results

blocks.heading: Context Engineering: Supply Appropriate Information Each Time
paragraphs: This practice belongs to context engineering: designing what information a model should receive, when it receives it, how valid state is retained and how irrelevant material is kept from interfering.

Tests and review must return to actual evidence rather than relying solely on AI’s completion claim. Record confirmed decisions in the authoritative specification so the next selection retrieves the valid version.

sections.heading: 6. Should You Start a New Conversation?
paragraphs: Continue the existing conversation when the goal is consistent, requirements do not conflict and relevant information remains clear. Length alone does not determine whether to restart.
When requirements have changed repeatedly, unrelated messages have accumulated or the agent keeps citing an outdated specification, prepare a handoff before starting a new work session.

A fresh conversation does not repair an incorrect specification. An incorrect summary can lead a new agent to repeat the same mistake. M02-03 explains compaction for compressing history, RAG for retrieving information and memory for retaining information for later use. They help manage long tasks while results still require correctness checks.

sections.heading: 7. Understanding Check: Can You Diagnose the Failure?
paragraphs: Suppose a coding agent is building an internal hospital system. Yesterday you specified: “Only administrators may delete medical-record-related entries.” Today the agent exposes deletion to every signed-in user. This is a synthetic teaching scenario without real patient data.

Answer Questions 1 and 2, then expand the reference answers to compare. When AI fails, distinguish missing information, an incorrect version and incorrect execution despite receiving the correct information, then choose the appropriate remedy.

exercise.environment: Paper or Python 3. Use only the assigned token counts; no actual model call is needed.
steps: Classify specifications, history and tool results as authoritative records, currently necessary material or retrievable evidence, explaining your choices.
Check the synthetic budget of 9,500 and remaining 500 using the slider or Python example.
Set extra logs to 1,800 tokens, confirm overflow of 800 and decide which irrelevant material to remove first.
Write a next-call task summary with specification version, sources, unresolved questions and scenarios still needing verification.
exercise.expected: Synthetic budget calculations and a source-traceable task packet, without claiming real service token measurements.
exercise.check: Explain the difference between fitting content and performing the task correctly, and identify information the next call must retrieve again.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic notes and optionally delete the temporary budget program. No external model or account is created.

openChecks.prompt: Question 2: How would you establish the actual cause?
answer: Identify the governing specification, version and exact administrator-only rule. Inspect the paths read by the agent, tool results and context actually available in this call. A stored file or visible chat history does not establish that this call received the rule.

If it was absent, repair selection or retrieval. If stale rules were mixed in, identify the valid version. If the correct rule was available but execution failed, inspect the changes and execution evidence. Test actual authorization for administrators and ordinary users, including server-side rejection of unauthorized deletion rather than button appearance alone. Establishing a capacity problem separately requires actual input and service-limit evidence beyond this teaching budget.

zh.prompt: 問題 1：你現在能夠判定錯誤原因嗎？
options: 可以，一定是 Context Window 滿了
可以，一定是模型能力不足
還不能，需要檢查實際上下文、版本及執行結果
可以，只要更換更大的模型就能解決
rationales: 僅看錯誤結果，無法證明容量不足或規則未進入上下文。
模型能力可能影響結果，但此情境尚未排除資料選取、版本與實作問題。
先查實際取得的規則與版本，再核對執行結果，才能區分沒取得、版本錯誤或使用失誤。
更大的模型不能保證補上未讀取的規格、排除版本衝突或修正實作錯誤。

en.prompt: Question 1: Can you determine the cause now?
options: Yes; the context window must be full
Yes; the model must lack capability
Not yet; inspect the actual context, versions and execution results
Yes; switching to a larger model will solve it
rationales: The failure alone does not establish insufficient capacity or absence of the rule from context.
Model capability may affect results, but selection, version and implementation problems have not been excluded.
Inspect the rules and versions actually supplied, then check execution results to distinguish missing information, a wrong version and incorrect use.
A larger model cannot guarantee retrieval of an unread specification, resolution of conflicting versions or a correct implementation.
